optimizedDescription.value: Pure graph-store traversal computes caller/callee, file, spec, change, canonical-symbol and covering-spec impact with depth-aware risk.

optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal

## Rules

- `getUpstream(store, symbolId, options?): Promise<TraversalResult>` — transitive callers to `maxDepth` (default 3), grouped 1-indexed by depth; `CALLS` reverse (target→source); cycles: symbol visited at shallower depth not revisited.
- `getDownstream(store, symbolId, options?)` — transitive callees to `maxDepth` (default 3), grouped by depth; `CALLS` forward; same cycle handling.
- `TraversalOptions`: `maxDepth` (number, default 3); `includeFiles` (boolean, default true — include `IMPORTS` in addition to `CALLS`). `TraversalResult`: `root`, `levels` (`Map<number, SymbolNode[]>`), `totalCount`, `truncated` (hit `maxDepth`, more may exist).
- `analyzeImpact(store, target, direction: 'upstream' | 'downstream' | 'both', maxDepth?)` — blast radius; `ImpactResult`: `target`, `directDependents` (depth-1, WILL BREAK), `indirectDependents` (depth-2, LIKELY AFFECTED), `transitiveDependents` (depth-3+, MAY NEED TESTING), `riskLevel`, `affectedFiles`, `affectedSymbols`, `affectedProcesses` (execution flows incl. target/affected). `AffectedSymbol`: `id`, `name`, `filePath`, `line` (1-based), `depth`.
- Risk thresholds (fixed): `LOW` 0–2 direct, no indirect; `MEDIUM` 3–5 direct or any indirect; `HIGH` 6+ direct or 10+ total; `CRITICAL` 20+ total or 3+ execution flows.
- All persisted symbol dependency relations are first-class blast-radius inputs: `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` (symbols); `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS` (types); `OVERRIDES` (methods). All feed depth counts, risk, file aggregation. `COVERS_SYMBOL` MAY contribute affected specs in requirement-aware views. Applies to symbol + file-impact aggregation.
- `analyzeFileImpact(store, filePath, direction, maxDepth?)` — `findSymbols({ filePath })` → per-symbol `analyzeImpact` → merge: dedupe symbols (shallowest depth), max risk, union files. `FileImpactResult extends ImpactResult` + `symbols` array; risk = max across symbols; hierarchy-derived impact reflected.
- `analyzeFilesImpact(store, filePaths, direction, maxDepth?)` — multi-file aggregate: union files/symbols, sum direct/indirect/transitive counts, risk = max.
- `analyzeSpecImpact(store, specId, direction, maxDepth?)` — requirement-aware; relations: `DEPENDS_ON` (Spec→Spec), `COVERS_FILE` (Spec→File), `COVERS_SYMBOL` (Spec→Symbol). Upstream: dependent specs + files/symbols covered by target + transitively affected dependent specs. Downstream: specs target depends on + files/symbols reached. `SpecImpactResult extends ImpactResult`; affected sets may originate from requirement-aware relations.
- `detectChanges(store, changedFiles, maxDepth?)` — per changed file: find symbols → upstream traversal each → aggregate symbols/files, risk, summary.
- Pure functions: stateless, in `domain/services/`; `GraphStore` read-only; value-object returns; no mutation, lifecycle, or cross-call state. No `@specd/core` dependency.
- Canonical resolution: unqualified prefers case-exact, falls back case-insensitive exact only when none; no prefix/component/textual matches. Unique candidate → traverse; multiple → bounded deterministic ambiguity, no traversal. Qualified/full selectors keep exact semantics. Public-export impact: one public-binding identity → two views — consumers of exact surface + exported name (incl. re-export chains) and all dependents of canonical symbol via every route. Retain binding, canonical target, ordered binding chain; ambiguity never merges or selects.
- Hierarchy traversal: preserves edge direction + language precedence (contracts, overrides, inherited members, traits, mixins, embedding, promotion, provable interface satisfaction). Cycles terminate; logical symbol with multiple declaration occurrences counted once. Deterministic ordering across backends; indexed lookups; bounded cycle-safe.
- `coveringSpecs` (`FileImpactResult`): deterministically ordered, from reverse `COVERS_FILE` + `COVERS_SYMBOL`; each spec once with min impact depth + every distinct evidence `{ kind: 'file' | 'symbol', target, depth }`. Input files + defined symbols depth 0; reached items use shallowest depth 1..maxDepth. Multi-file: all inputs + symbols depth 0, aggregate evidence; order by min depth, spec id, evidence depth, kind, target. File coverage visible without symbol coverage; symbol coverage augments, never gates/replaces. Reverse coverage batched over deduped file+symbol sets — no per-result queries. Read-only; projects coverage present in open graph; completeness reporting owned by graph-health/freshness consumers.

## Constraints

- `maxDepth` default 3, overridable via `TraversalOptions`.
- Cycles: symbol reported only at shallowest depth.
- Risk thresholds fixed, non-configurable.
- Functions in `domain/services/` only — not use cases/infrastructure.
- Never mutate store; no state between calls.
- No `@specd/core` dependency.
